scenes.title: Your final project
scenes.accessibleDescription: Use a manageable idea to demonstrate the complete process.

scenes.title: Capture and align
scenes.accessibleDescription: Turn a raw idea into an agreed journey with explicit unknowns.

scenes.title: Research and decide
scenes.accessibleDescription: Show what evidence exists and why consequential choices were made.

scenes.title: Map and specify
scenes.accessibleDescription: A simple diagram and a precise contract explain how the system should work.

scenes.title: Plan the kickoff
scenes.accessibleDescription: Give a fresh agent an ordered, bounded assignment and clear checks.

scenes.title: Review it cold
scenes.accessibleDescription: Test whether someone without the conversation can find the first safe action.

scenes.title: Choose a small scope
scenes.accessibleDescription: A focused first version is easier to specify and verify.

scenes.title: Assess the readback
scenes.accessibleDescription: A complete journey identifies the actor, trigger, actions, and result.

scenes.title: Assess the design
scenes.accessibleDescription: Trace both a valid request and a storage failure across the map.

scenes.title: Assess the contract
scenes.accessibleDescription: A fresh reader should be able to say exactly how each requirement is proven.

scenes.title: Assess the handoff
scenes.accessibleDescription: The next agent needs authority, baseline, evidence, and a safe next step.

scenes.title: Use the feedback
scenes.accessibleDescription: Record what a reader had to guess, then revise and check again.

scenes.title: Transfer the work
scenes.accessibleDescription: Keep stable decisions and environment-specific assumptions visible.
